rounds.text: Savita Oil Technologies Ltd trades at an attractive P/E multiple of 11.4x, sitting below its sector benchmark of 14.19x [E1, E6]. The business demonstrates explosive recent fundamental acceleration, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of 222% and a quarterly operating margin reaching 25% in June 2026 compared to 6% in the prior-year quarter [E19, E28]. This momentum is underpinned by a sector tailwind score of +0.57 and double-digit volume growth across all divisions in Q4 FY26 [E68, E72]. Furthermore, the company commands a fortress balance sheet with nil borrowings and substantial cash, cash equivalents, and investments standing near ₹508 crores as of March 31, 2026 [E77, E78]. Domestic institutions have noticeably increased their stake by 5.76 percentage points since September 2023, accompanied by positive institutional money flow [E40, E41]. Conceded: the DCF intrinsic value calculation puts shares slightly below the current market price at ₹668, resulting in a negative margin of safety [E42, E43].
